description: Token provider failure marked temporary (MCPWARP.md §5.2; CLIENT-SDK.md Provider failure row): the provider fails with the SDK's token-unavailable marker, so the dial attempt ends before the socket factory (no dial counted) and is a failed dial: connecting + RETRYING with the dial lastError, normal backoff (T27). A second unavailable result keeps RETRYING (no snapshot); then the provider returns the token and the redial goes online.
